title: Lake Retreat
description:
Sleeps up to 8 people in 4 queen beds. Swim in the resort style gunite swimming pool with swim up bar, infinity edge sitting area and swim up bar. Spa is open year round. Pool is open March 1 through September 15. Architecturally inspired cupola and spacious windows let in tons of natural light. Enjoy the complimentary kayaks (4 included) or just relax at the boat dock. This is a unique place only 20 minutes to Nashville restaurants and nightlife

The space
This a completely detached guesthouse. Upstairs and downstairs included. Upstairs is a beautiful space with full kitchen (granite countertops, dishwasher, fridge, stove) queen bed with memory foam mattress, pull out queen sofa bed with memory foam mattress, walk-in shower with 2 vanities. Huge flatscreen tv and back deck with sitting area overlooking the lake

Downstairs is completely separate and has a 2 queen beds. This has another large flatscreen tv, heat and air conditioning, and a workout gym with free weights and treadmill. Please keep in mind anyone sleeping downstairs will need to go upstairs to use the bathroom.

The resort style pool is yours to enjoy. A boat dock with kayaks are included for you to use

Guest access
Entire 2 levels of the detached guesthouse
